items.prompt: What do you do — are you working or studying at the moment?
What do you enjoy most about your work or studies?
Is there anything you find difficult or stressful about it?
Do you think you'll still be doing the same thing in five years? Why or why not?
What's one skill you'd like to improve, and how would you go about it?
What do you usually do in your free time?
How did you first get interested in that?
Do you prefer spending your free time alone or with other people? Why?
Is there a hobby you used to enjoy but don't do anymore? What happened?
Is there something new you'd like to try in the future?
Can you tell me a little about the place where you grew up?
What do you like most about living there — or wherever you live now?
Has the area changed much since you were younger?
Would you like to live somewhere else one day? Where, and why?
What are you most looking forward to in the next year or two?
Do you enjoy cooking, or do you prefer someone else to cook for you?
What's a typical meal you eat during a normal week?
Has the way you eat changed at all in the last few years?
Is there a food you disliked as a child but enjoy now, or the other way round?
If you could learn to cook one new dish really well, what would it be?
How much do you rely on your phone or computer during a normal day?
What's an app or piece of technology you find really useful?
Do you think people spend too much time online these days?
Was there a piece of technology you found hard to get used to at first?
How do you think everyday technology might change over the next ten years?
Do you enjoy shopping, or is it just something you have to do?
Do you prefer shopping in actual shops or online? Why?
Are you someone who plans purchases carefully, or do you buy things on impulse?
What was the last thing you bought that you were really pleased with?
Do you think it's important to save money regularly? Why or why not?
